**Build is green again.** Exit code 0.

Two real bugs were hiding in the warning noise.

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`. The bump renamed that to `retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on an unset flag. The new loader leaves it `undefined`, meaning off.

The remaining 8 warnings are just noise. They name files this repo does not have.
